assumptions.statement: The coordinated research scope is available only as an official approximate 43.6 km² figure; no submission polygon is provided.

assumptions.statement: The submitted overall-design boundary is a repository provisional rough polygon, not an official redline.

assumptions.resolution_trigger: A trusted official overall-design boundary polygon is supplied.
assumptions.replacement_action: Replace SITE-001, regenerate every editable geometry layer and recalculate all area, length and ratio metrics in EPSG:4548.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints derived from announced names, north-to-south sequence and approximate areas.
assumptions.impact: Landmark, scenario, building-envelope and public-space locations are area-level concepts rather than parcel or engineering positions.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official rights-cleared polygons for all three key areas are supplied.
assumptions.replacement_action: Replace the three provisional KEY_AREA features and relocate or verify every dependent scenario, public-space, landmark and building feature.

assumptions.statement: The twelve land-use faces are a conceptual functional partition generated for the Jing-Zhang Protocol, not existing or statutory land use.
assumptions.impact: Codes test program compatibility and topology only; they create no planning entitlement or parcel-level control conclusion.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Verified current land use and approved detailed-control data are supplied.
assumptions.replacement_action: Crosswalk the concept programs to verified parcels, preserve the protocol logic where compatible, and replace all concept-code areas and ratios.

assumptions.statement: The twelve scenario points are area-level spatial indices for linking service logic to carrier spaces, not surveyed installation coordinates.
assumptions.impact: A point proves conceptual assignment and operating metadata, not parcel availability, construction feasibility or approved siting.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Verified carrier spaces, ownership, utilities, access and operator agreements are available for a scenario.
assumptions.replacement_action: Replace that scenario point with a surveyed carrier-space geometry or approved installation record and revalidate every host reference.

assumptions.statement: The three phase polygons encode first-intervention packages and evidence dependencies rather than time, investment or construction promises.
assumptions.impact: Sequence numbers cannot be read as government schedules; each package advances only after its stated evidence gate is met.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: An authorized implementation body confirms projects, budgets, approvals and dates.
assumptions.replacement_action: Translate dependency packages into an approved delivery plan, retain gate conditions and replace sequence-only language with confirmed milestones.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire, flood and engineering constraints are not available.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, building density, setbacks, road area and confirmed capacity remain unknown and no statutory conclusion is made.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Approved control, utility, fire, flood, transport and ownership packages are available.
assumptions.replacement_action: Populate the empty constraint layer with verified features, replace unknown metrics and rerun professional design and engineering review.

assumptions.statement: A rights-cleared existing-building and ownership survey is not available.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are program envelopes only; no retain, renovate, demolish, new-build or ownership decision is asserted.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: A surveyed existing-building, condition, ownership and occupancy dataset is available.
assumptions.replacement_action: Replace concept envelopes with surveyed buildings and assign retain, renovate, remove or infill actions through professional and stakeholder review.

assumptions.statement: Road-centerline features represent conceptual walking, cycling, transit-connection or service relationships.
assumptions.impact: They are not road redlines, construction alignments, traffic-capacity claims or approvals and require transport and engineering verification.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Verified road redlines, rail exits, counts, accessibility audits and engineering conditions are available.
assumptions.replacement_action: Replace design lines with verified network data, recalculate lengths and areas, and test capacity, safety and universal access.

assumptions.statement: Official heritage protection ranges and construction-control zones have not been supplied.

assumptions.resolution_trigger: Rights-cleared heritage boundaries, object lists and conservation controls are supplied.
assumptions.replacement_action: Add verified heritage constraints and revise landmark programs, sightlines, excavation limits and public-space interventions with conservation professionals.

assumptions.statement: No verified project baseline for enterprises, talent, output, vacancies, compute capacity or investment is supplied.
